function.description: Submit any advertised formal Plan action directly; research_route is optional for unresolved tool/action ambiguity. Main owns hypothesis, variables, evidence, effort and stopping conditions. Original admission still applies.

CoupledInteraction.description: The existing four-point backend; this is not an iterative optimizer.

comparison_load_conditions.description: compare only: additional frozen loads on the identical assembly. Do not also select a comparison candidate.

execution_checks.description: Passive finite-time research: legacy screening checks routing on the score grid while retaining physics, dense qualification and full traces. Use execution_profile for scoped exploration. Diagnostic screening cannot certify task acceptance. full retains every frozen check.

load_aggregation.description: Optional deterministic extremum of scalar compared load-case observations; no new optimizer or gradient.

local_radius_fraction.description: Bounded neighborhood in normalized parameter coordinates, used by the existing SciPy local optimizer.

native_state_selection.description: With saved_state set to an owned completed Native T1/Direct result, choose a real state from its best complete control. Omit to retain legacy saved-state semantics.

parameter_bounds.description: Finite local intervals for selected actual parameter_paths, required for open domains. Preserve the full FamilySpace; include the current value and obey physical bounds. These intervals apply only to this request.

parameter_group.description: Actual capability category; segment_lengths is retained as a legacy selector.

parameter_paths.description: Exactly two distinct registered continuous parameters on the same baseline. All other parameters, task and conditions are fixed.

passive_ablation.description: Passive v2 finite-time research only: exact tendon limit names for each paired evaluation; twice the episode budget.

requested_budget.description: Four matched points: baseline, A only, B only, A+B. Omit or choose 4; repeat exploration in a new Plan.

EvidenceRef.description: Use the stable short reference in the research packet or an evidence response.

FamilyMixedSearchV2.description: Four matched local interaction points only: baseline, A, B, A+B. No optimize operation or iterative evaluation budget. Use a new Plan for further exploration.

payout_offsets_m.description: Independent SI offset above each actual zero-state routed tendon length; geometry edits recompute the reference. Omitted offsets use 0.0 m.

time_s.description: best_sample only: exact saved control-grid time; never interpolated. Missing integration state requires charged prefix reconstruction in the original model.

PassiveExecutionProfile.description: Choose exploration scope explicitly. For final_acceptance, omit load_conditions, stage_prefix, observation_window_s, sample_period_s, route_sampling, recording and requested_observables: the Worker uses the entire frozen protocol. This does not grant acceptance or require an ablation for baseline research.

fidelity.description: Use an exact declared Fidelity name, not a physical description. Names and cells/segment: screening=2, screening1=1, refinement2=2, diagnostic12=12, diagnostic16=16, diagnostic32=32, diagnostic4=4, diagnostic8=8, final_evaluation=2. Null keeps the candidate discretization.

requested_observables.description: Optional recorded observables, not free-text research goals. Omit for default observations. Native diagnostics include tendon_transitions, stiffness_ratio, slack_to_taut and stage_qualification; task observation names and evaluator bound names/quantities are also supported.

stage_prefix.description: Exploration only: execute continuously from the frozen initial state through this stage; omit for the complete program.

projection_world.description: Orthonormal world output rows for declared row-space coverage; choose a direction or subspace explicitly.

candidate.description: Replay candidate; decision.selected_candidate must equal this reference. Both candidate and source belong inside physical_replay.

initial_state_result.description: passive_response_v2 only: current owned completed physical result containing a qualified complete integration state.

passive_ablation.description: passive_response_v2 only: exact passive tendon entities; two fresh paired native executions, double episode budget.

source.description: Active: exact complete control schedule. Registered passive task: omit to bind its frozen loading protocol.

validation_source.description: Registered passive numerical confirmation only: current owned completed paired physical result. A fresh independent pair, constrained half-timestep and initial perturbation executions plus saved-CSV state checks form the complete frozen confirmation scope. No historical candidate transfer.

ResearchDecision.description: Main chooses hypothesis, candidate and scientific variables. The host derives research_intent from the explicit Plan action before original validation.

claimed_inference.description: Use empirical_search for a proposed experiment, including testing a prediction in physics. Unsupported stronger claims remain annotated hypotheses and do not veto an otherwise legal experiment. Formal conclusions and SELECT/CONFIRM/STOP still require registered scoped evidence; execution always requires valid identity, authorization, applicability and budget.

requested_budget.description: Declared request cap, not actual cost or authorization. For Plan control_search match settings.evaluation_requests (physical replay callbacks); otherwise declared operation units. Zero independent physical evaluations does not imply zero Native integration. Missing formal scope and unknown costs remain unresolved until normal admission.

selected_candidate.description: Required for execute/initialize_control/control_search/physical_replay. Match candidate, control_seed.candidate, control_search.candidate or physical_replay.candidate respectively; never substitute the control source. For diagnose, place the owned candidate here at decision.selected_candidate; there is no top-level selected_candidate field.

selected_method.description: Optional action intent label; no solver name is required. The scientific question selects semantics after diagnose.

mode.description: Choose the whole task, an explicit correction window, or a frozen Reach/Hold phase. Phase/window corrections have zero endpoints. Evaluation always retains the complete frozen task and every constraint.

window_s.description: Only control corrections inside this interval; evaluation still covers the complete frozen task.

ScientificGeneration.description: An explicit physical edit of the selected parent; no automatic experiment.

changes.description: Registered physical parameter IDs mapped to absolute SI values. Copy all other parent fields exactly. Empty explicitly reconstructs the unchanged selected parent at the current implementation; old results and acceptance do not transfer. Parent is decision.selected_candidate.

additional_control_sources.description: Optional explicitly selected additional starts for the same candidate and frozen condition. No automatic source selection.

model_results.description: Saved Conic-compatible model stencil, baseline first. Original optimal sensitivity admission determines its validity.

t1_results.description: Comparable saved Native T1 results, baseline first; may select explicit shared-baseline paths/scales. No new search is requested.

bounds.description: Finite ordered local subranges for selected search coordinates, within the frozen physical domain. Required for every selected open coordinate. design_variable_groups.description: Real structure groups only. Mesh convergence is a separate generation/comparison study, not physical task improvement.

initial_segment_count.description: Explicit numerical starting point within selected range, not a claim of optimal topology.

section_types.description: Omit to retain original prototype section kinds; dimension changes still use frozen domains.

segment_counts.description: Choose finite positive topology counts; omit only for a frozen finite grant. An open FamilySpace requires explicit finite choices. Topology is discrete, never a continuous gradient.

span_strategies.description: Omit to explore legal strategies when spans is selected, otherwise retain original whole_chain search default.

angular_offsets_rad.description: Extra offsets: theta_j = phase_rad + 2*pi*j/count + angular_offsets_rad[j]. Empty uses equal spacing. These are not absolute angles.

first_segment.description: Frozen FamilySpace requires a fixed-base start. last_segment chooses the anchor segment; other span variables remain selectable.

supporting_evidence.description: Cite every result in research_workflow.evaluations / all_fresh_results, including failures across candidates. Use advertised short references. For final_acceptance, omit load_conditions, stage_prefix, observation_window_s, sample_period_s, route_sampling, recording and requested_observables: the Worker uses the entire frozen protocol. This does not grant acceptance or require an ablation for baseline research.

fidelity.description: Use an exact declared Fidelity name, not a physical description. Names and cells/segment: screening=2, screening1=1, refinement2=2, diagnostic12=12, diagnostic16=16, diagnostic32=32, diagnostic4=4, diagnostic8=8, final_evaluation=2. Null keeps the candidate discretization.

requested_observables.description: Optional recorded observables, not free-text research goals. Omit for default observations. Native diagnostics include tendon_transitions, stiffness_ratio, slack_to_taut and stage_qualification; task observation names and evaluator bound names/quantities are also supported.

stage_prefix.description: Exploration only: execute continuously from the frozen initial state through this stage; omit for the complete program.

goal.description: Main explicitly chooses increase or decrease for differentiation or optimization.

projection_world.description: Orthonormal world output rows for declared row-space coverage; choose a direction or subspace explicitly.

quantity.description: instantaneous_braking is the signed d(speed)/dt range [minimum, maximum], in m/s^2. Strongest deceleration corresponds to the minimum endpoint (more negative); maximum/increase raises the upper speed-up endpoint. No sign inversion or target conversion is automatic.

ScientificStructureV4.description: Choose operation, effect semantics, target, and parameters. Hypothesis and evaluation cap may reuse the completed diagnose decision. Only uniquely implied execution fields are compiled; distinct working points, sources and scientific methods remain Main choices.

comparison_load_conditions.description: compare only: additional frozen loads on the identical assembly. Do not also select a comparison candidate.

load_aggregation.description: Optional deterministic extremum of scalar compared load-case observations; no new optimizer or gradient.

local_radius_fraction.description: Bounded neighborhood in normalized parameter coordinates, used by the existing SciPy local optimizer.

native_state_selection.description: With saved_state set to an owned completed Native T1/Direct result, choose a real state from its best complete control. Omit to retain legacy saved-state semantics.

parameter_bounds.description: Finite local intervals for selected actual parameter_paths, required for open domains. Preserve the full FamilySpace; include the current value and obey physical bounds. These intervals apply only to this request.

parameter_group.description: Actual capability category; segment_lengths is retained as a legacy selector.

parameter_paths.description: Candidate-bound selectable continuous parameters under the frozen Study grant. Full structure_parameters retains design domains, authorization and unavailable reasons. The original compiler still checks the chosen operation, method, working point and shared budgets before execution. Evidence JSON navigation pointers are not parameter IDs.

passive_ablation.description: Passive v2 finite-time research only: exact tendon limit names for each paired evaluation; twice the episode budget.

requested_budget.description: Optional maximum original mathematical evaluations for this question. An explicit cap is never increased. With no question or diagnose cap, the compiler selects the actual legal minimum after method/parameter/working-point admission. Costs include baseline, legal two-scale probes, joint check and bounded search; shared budgets still apply. Fixed-input short responses retain original accounting. For explicit control optimization this caps Native callbacks; saved M2 aggregation never requests new T1 rollouts.

target.description: Static research: registered PhysicalMechanismTarget. Optional low-cost unloaded qualification: operation inspect, quantity constraint_active_set, frozen baseline load, re_equilibrated point; frozen initialization only, zero loading episodes. Complete finite_time_task_response: exact string finite_time_task_violation, all frozen conditions, qualification gates and requested_budget; no single diagnostic substitutes for the full objective.

parameters.description: Root fields only: version, domain, structure. Put execution options inside the selected structure/control payload. The completed diagnose Plan already owns the hypothesis and candidate. Structure research uses inspect/differentiate/optimize/compare/interact (two registered continuous parameters, four matched local points); control research uses control feasibility and effort. Joint structure-control search uses the existing research_plan(search) interface. Main owns all scientific choices.

function.description: Read-only investigation of saved results: provide a question and result references; exact reads and authorized experience_queries are optional. No candidate is needed to read existing evidence. This does not execute research_plan(diagnose) or candidate-bound research_analysis. Returns compact findings and an interpretation_query; internal reads give no SELECT/STOP credit.
function.name: research_investigate

EvidenceIntentQuery.description: Scientific discovery; registered choices, never arbitrary JSON paths.

group.description: Exact registered group returned by this topic; unknown groups return choices.
group.title: Group

selection.description: Explicit registered object or method/primitive identifiers returned in choices; no implicit scientific selection.
selection.title: Selection

EvidenceQuery.description: Exact evidence review and formal acceptance, also retained for saved callers.

fields.description: Immediate child keys at an object pointer, not dotted paths. Use with view=fields for raw JSON, or with view=working_set/mathematical_capabilities to select fields inside that derived view. For a working_set list select a row by /control_result_links/<index> first; do not switch to raw view=fields for derived paths.
fields.title: Fields

pointer.description: Absolute JSON Pointer; use summary to discover child keys. Permanent Store references survive session handoff; temporary SDK offload references do not.
pointer.title: Pointer

EvidenceQuery.title: EvidenceQuery

EvidenceRef.description: Use the stable short reference in the research packet or an evidence response.

knowledge_type.description: Explicit knowledge, skill or expert_process role in typed manifests; legacy procedure/case mapping remains unchanged. Frozen authorization still applies.
knowledge_type.title: Knowledge Type

limit.description: Optional search result count. Omit to return all authorized metadata. Exact reads identify one entry/revision.
limit.title: Limit

type.description: Knowledge category in an explicitly enabled typed manifest; does not widen authorization.
type.title: Type

experience_queries.description: Optional curated procedural search/exact read. Guidance only; never scientific sources or formal reading credit.
experience_queries.title: Experience Queries

focus.description: Scientific questions for interpretation; does not select automatic topics. Use reads for registered topic/group/selection detail.
focus.title: Focus

reads.description: Optional scientific subject/topic/group/selection queries. Exact old EvidenceQuery remains for deliberate raw review. Neither grants formal reading credit.
reads.title: Reads

subject.description: Owned candidate or saved results/reports only. Read the frozen task directly with evidence_read(subject=current_task, topic=task).
subject.title: Subject
